description: Use when you need a quick housing-market snapshot for a South Korean district-month instead of raw trades. Data: MOLIT reported apartment sales, cancelled deals excluded. Input: region (5-digit LAWD_CD, e.g. 11680), month (YYYYMM). Output: JSON count, median/average/min/max price and price per m2 and per pyeong in KRW and USD, breakdown by size class, top complexes by volume. Example: ?region=11680&month=202609 Price: $0.0045 USDC (Base or Solana) via x402.

month.description: Contract month YYYYMM, 200601 to the current month (KST)

region.description: 5-digit 시군구 code (LAWD_CD), e.g. 11680 = Seoul Gangnam-gu. Unknown codes → 400 (not charged).

name: kr_apartment_trades_summary
title: Korea apartment price summary for a district-month (count, median/avg price and price per m²)
